description: A two-position switch putting out a steady 0V or 10V by hand, with a text area for writing down what it is patched to

params.text: Puts out 0V in one position and 10V in the other

notes: the dark area on the panel takes typed text, for labelling what the switch controls; the text is saved with the patch
shift-dragging up or down on the module name changes the colour of the panel, and holding ctrl as well makes the change finer
